assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional computation frames, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive geometry, ratios, figures and phasing must be regenerated when official polygons are obtained.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Rights-cleared official CAD/GIS/PDF with source, version and CRS recorded.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks and building-control lines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The proposal does not state approved development-intensity controls.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, uses, heights, age, condition and ownership are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons illustrate reusable spatial typologies only; no parcel-level retain, renovate or demolish conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, flows, station limits, parking and traffic-safety data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Road features are desired connection concepts, not engineering alignments.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection limits, park implementation limits, water-control lines and construction-control zones are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All landscape, landmark and public-space suggestions remain conservative and reversible pending specialist review.

assumptions.statement: Ownership, funding, statutory approval, municipal capacity and responsible implementation bodies are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Phases are decision gates, not committed dates, budgets or construction promises.
